report.explanation: Memory-retention series for order shows only a small increase (10 to 60 bytes, delta 50) with no GC pair and is classified INSUFFICIENT; a short increase alone cannot establish a leak. Alert-aligned facts show 6 successes, 0 errors, and ~1ms p95, so no fault is established. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handing off.
missing_evidence: Longer memory-retention series for order to establish a sustained trend
GC pair observations with reclaimed_bytes_after_gc to distinguish leak from normal retention
Evidence of user-visible impact (errors, latency) aligned to the alert
